description: Line coverage sign-off exclusions for the accelerator VCS VDB fallback parser. The excluded bins are simulation-only trace hooks, defensive error paths, generated-lane clamp alternatives checked by end-to-end directed tests, and parameter-arm bookkeeping that is covered by the configuration sweep rather than by every fixed elaboration.
